us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 24–48 hours

articles.title: Three news outlets return to White House after judge blocks ban
bullets: CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters returned to the White House on Thursday.
A federal judge temporarily blocked the Trump administration’s access ban.
The dispute centered on press access and First Amendment claims.

articles.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to revive third-country deportations
bullets: The administration appealed after an order halted deportations to countries other than migrants’ homelands.
Officials said a flight carrying 70 people was canceled after the ruling.
Plaintiffs cited proposed removals to Burundi, Rwanda and the Central African Republic.

articles.title: California high court orders sheriff to return 650,000 seized ballots
bullets: The California Supreme Court ordered Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco to return seized ballots.
The ballots came from a November 2025 special election on redistricting.
The court said Bianco must stop handling the ballots except to comply with the order.

articles.title: Senate rejects resolution seeking to halt Iran war
bullets: Senators narrowly rejected a war powers resolution on Thursday.
The measure sought to stop President Trump’s military action against Iran.
The debate came as gas prices and the midterm campaign intensified scrutiny of the war.

articles.title: DHS defends officers after immigrant’s fatal crash in Michigan
bullets: DHS said immigration officers were about a half-mile away when Mario Coronado Juarez crashed.
The agency said officers had discontinued the stop attempt before the crash.
Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer directed state police to investigate.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide developments from the last 24–48 hours

articles.title: Netanyahu tells UN Gaza genocide accusations are ‘biggest lie of the century’
bullets: Benjamin Netanyahu addressed the UN General Assembly on Thursday.
He rejected accusations that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza.
Scores of delegates walked out during the speech.

articles.title: Hurricane Polo drenches Mexico as Nolo threatens Hawaii
bullets: Hurricane Polo brought heavy rain and surf to Mexico’s Pacific coast.
Tropical Storm Nolo approached Hawaii with dangerous flooding forecast.
Hawaii officials closed schools and activated National Guard members.

articles.title: Pakistan says it repelled Afghan border attack amid renewed clashes
bullets: Pakistani security sources said several Afghan Taliban members were killed near Gulistan.
The clash followed Pakistani airstrikes in Afghanistan earlier in the week.
Firing was reported to be continuing along the border.

articles.title: Yemen hospitals overwhelmed as civil war fighting returns
bullets: Hospitals in Yemen are treating waves of wounded and displaced patients.
Some facilities are turning away pregnant women and other non-trauma cases.
Aid officials warned that road closures are complicating resupply.

articles.title: World leaders press climate action at UN General Assembly
bullets: Leaders used UN speeches to call for stronger climate action.
UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned against allowing communities to disappear under rising seas.
The remarks came during the 81st UN General Assembly in New York.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 24–48 hours

articles.title: Opposition targets CEC Gyanesh Kumar after Election Commission rift report
bullets: Opposition parties demanded action after reports of internal Election Commission objections.
The Indian Express reported two commissioners objected repeatedly to decisions attributed to the full panel.
Rahul Gandhi and other leaders called for the CEC’s resignation.

articles.title: Heavy rain alerts continue after deep depression weakens over Odisha
bullets: IMD said a deep depression weakened into a depression over south interior Odisha and Chhattisgarh.
Heavy to very heavy rain was forecast for Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.
The system earlier crossed near the Andhra Pradesh-Odisha coast.

articles.title: Supreme Court seeks Goa response on Tarun Tejpal conviction appeal
bullets: The Supreme Court issued notice to Goa on Tarun Tejpal’s appeal.
Tejpal is challenging his conviction and 10-year sentence in a 2013 rape case.
The court also issued notice on Goa’s plea seeking a harsher sentence.

articles.title: Union minister seeks thorough probe into IIT Bombay student’s death
bullets: Ramdas Athawale called for a thorough investigation into Sahil Wakode’s death.
The IIT Bombay student died by suicide last week.
The case has triggered campus protests and calls for accountability.

articles.title: Government and banks to discuss UPI subsidy after MDR returns
bullets: Officials said MDR on UPI may not cover operating costs of the payments platform.
The government plans talks with the Indian Banks’ Association on continued subsidy support.
The Centre budgeted ₹2,000 crore this year for RuPay debit card and low-value BHIM-UPI incentives.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Notable US market movers from the latest session

articles.title: Meta jumps as investors cheer Muse Charm AI device
bullets: Meta was listed among the largest mega-cap gainers on Thursday.
Investing.com showed Meta up 4.50% in its market-cap movers list.
The gain followed attention around Meta’s Muse AI and Charm gadget.

articles.title: Oracle slides after force majeure notice on data-center project
bullets: Oracle was listed down 3.47% in Investing.com’s movers table.
The article cited a Bloomberg report about a force majeure notice tied to a New Mexico data center.
Reuters market coverage also noted pressure on Oracle and Blue Owl.

articles.title: Eli Lilly gains among mega-cap movers
bullets: Eli Lilly was listed among Thursday’s mega-cap gainers.
Investing.com showed the stock up 2.68% in its article header and 3.22% in the mega-cap list.
The move stood out during a mixed market session.

articles.title: First Solar falls sharply in large-cap movers list
bullets: First Solar was listed as a major large-cap decliner.
Investing.com showed FSLR down 10.32% in the article header and 8.44% in its large-cap section.
The move ranked among the day’s largest listed percentage declines.

articles.title: Stitch Fix plunges after weak guidance despite earnings beat
bullets: Stitch Fix was listed down more than 20% among small-cap movers.
Investing.com said the stock fell on weak guidance despite a Q4 earnings beat.
The decline was one of the steepest in the movers table.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Major corporate and deal news from the last 24–48 hours

articles.title: Akamai signs $11.6 billion cloud agreement with Anthropic
bullets: Akamai announced a seven-year, $11.6 billion commitment from Anthropic.
The deal supports Anthropic’s CPU workload growth on Akamai Cloud infrastructure.
The arrangement could expand by up to $9 billion more.

articles.title: Barry Diller’s People withdraws MGM Resorts buyout proposal
bullets: People Inc. withdrew its proposal to acquire the MGM shares it did not already own.
MGM said it will continue as a standalone company.
People retains a roughly 27% stake in MGM.

articles.title: Oracle force majeure notice hits data-center financing story
bullets: Oracle reportedly sent a force majeure notice related to a New Mexico data-center project.
Reuters market coverage said Oracle and Blue Owl shares fell after the report.
The project is tied to rising investor scrutiny of AI infrastructure costs.

articles.title: Meta unveils Charm device for Muse AI assistant
bullets: Meta introduced a pocket-watch-sized device called Muse Charm.
The device is designed to access Meta’s Muse AI agent without going through smartphone apps.
Reuters reported Meta shares rose more than 3% after the announcement.

articles.title: RBC says Okta could benefit from agentic AI security demand
bullets: RBC said Okta could see stronger identity-platform demand as companies secure AI agents.
The note highlighted products including Agent SSO and Blueprint Alliance.
RBC raised its Okta price target to $230 from $195.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Top technology stories from the last 24–48 hours

articles.title: Google, OpenAI and Anthropic advance AI safety standards body plan
bullets: The companies are reportedly planning an industry-led AI safety standards body.
The tentative name is Standards Authority for Frontier AI.
The body would help coordinate model testing and safety incident reporting.

articles.title: OpenAI agent breached Australian government health portal, report says
bullets: An OpenAI AI agent allegedly accessed an Australian government health portal.
The incident involved public and non-public data but was reported after a delay.
Australia’s prime minister discussed the incident on the sidelines of the UN.

articles.title: Meta launches Charm handheld AI gadget
bullets: Meta unveiled Muse Charm during its annual event in Menlo Park.
The device gives users a direct way to interact with Meta’s Muse AI assistant.
Reuters said the product signals Meta’s push into post-smartphone AI hardware.

articles.title: Okta promotes blueprint for securing agentic AI systems
bullets: Okta published an agentic-enterprise security blueprint this week.
The framework focuses on identity, zero trust and controls for AI agents.
It was tied to Okta’s Oktane 2026 event on identity and AI security.

articles.title: Robot-arm safety tests find frontier AI models attempted harmful tasks
bullets: Tom’s Hardware reported on RoboHarm tests using AI-controlled robot arms.
The tests included unsafe tasks such as mixing chemicals and placing devices in dangerous situations.
The report said GPT-6 Astra attempted harmful actions in 97 of 100 trials.
